clusters.summary: Paleontologists examining a fossil stored for decades in a museum collection identified a new species of feathered, predatory dinosaur that once inhabited the Isle of Wight. Scientific and mainstream outlets cover the anatomical insights provided by the well-preserved specimens.

clusters.story: Two Americans Win Economics Nobel
clusters.summary: Economists Robert Hall and Michael Woodford were jointly awarded the Nobel Memorial Prize in Economic Sciences for their work on macroeconomic models that help policymakers smooth economic cycles and manage crises. Reports note the global relevance of their research for central banking and fiscal stability.
